mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hyponatremia and hypokalemia increase duloxetine's risk of hyponatremia (SIADH) and electrolyte depletion; additive effects on blood pressure reduction.
action: Monitor serum sodium, potassium, and blood pressure regularly; consider alternative antihypertensive if hyponatremia or hypokalemia develops; educate patient on hyponatremia symptoms.
